top_signals.title: Treasuries Rise as Oil Retreats From Highest Levels in Weeks
top_signals.summary: Treasuries rose as benchmark oil prices retreated from the highest levels in weeks, prompting traders to trim wagers on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes over the coming year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: WestJet Bonds Slide to Record Low as Fuel, Trade Tensions Rise
top_signals.summary: WestJet Airlines Ltd., Canada’s second-largest air carrier, saw its bonds fall to their lowest level since they were issued in June, as spikes in the cost of fuel and trade tensions are dimming its earnings outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
